page.overview:
Who is Paul?

Paul is a minor character in Invincible, debuting from Season 2 and onward.

He is a real estate agent who works with Debbie Grayson and is her ex-boyfriend.

Paul worked in real estate and was a co-worker of Debbie. When Omni-Man's true motives were revealed and he fled the planet, Debbie fell into a state of grief, which Paul noticed.

Paul is seen with Debbie trying to sell a house to a couple. When the husband argues over buying the house, Paul defuses the situation by showing them out.
